title: Taqdimot qilish san’ati
goal_uz: Dars oxirida aniq tuzilmali (kirish, uch asosiy fikr, xulosa) uch daqiqalik taqdimot tayyorlaysiz, signpost iboralar bilan tinglovchini yo‘naltirasiz, auditoriyani savol va hikoya bilan jalb qilasiz hamda savollarga ishonchli va diplomatik javob bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Taqdimot qilish san’ati
board: The Art of Presenting
(Taqdimot qilish san’ati)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda iqtisod va biznes lug‘atini o‘rgandik: tendensiyalar, raqamlar, muhokama iboralari. Bugun shu bilimni sahnaga olib chiqamiz: taqdimot qilishni o‘rganamiz. Universitetda, ishda yoki konferensiyada, ingliz tilida taqdimot qilish C1 darajasining eng amaliy ko‘nikmalaridan biri. Dars oxirida uch daqiqalik taqdimot tuzib, uni ishonch bilan ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we explored the language of business. Today we put it on stage: you will learn to plan and deliver a clear, engaging three-minute presentation.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar biznes tilini o‘rgandik. Bugun uni sahnaga olib chiqamiz: aniq va qiziqarli uch daqiqalik taqdimot tuzish va aytishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Yaxshi taqdimot siri
board: Tell them what you'll tell them
Tell them
Tell them what you've told them
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilidagi taqdimotlarda mashhur bir qoida bor: avval nima haqida gapirishingizni ayting, keyin gapiring, oxirida nima aytganingizni yana bir bor eslating. Bu takrorlash ortiqcha emas. Tinglovchi matnni o‘quvchiga o‘xshab orqaga qaytib o‘qiy olmaydi, shuning uchun unga aniq xarita kerak. Bugungi to‘rt nuqta: tuzilma, yo‘naltiruvchi iboralar, auditoriyani jalb qilish va savollarga javob.
scenes.say: Tell them what you're going to tell them. Tell them. Then tell them what you've told them. Listeners cannot reread, so give them a clear map.
scenes.say_uz: Ularga nima aytishingizni ayting. Ayting. Keyin nima aytganingizni ayting. Tinglovchi qayta o‘qiy olmaydi, shuning uchun unga aniq xarita bering.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: kirish qismi
board: Greet + introduce yourself
Topic + purpose
Outline + length
Questions: now or at the end?

examples.t: The purpose of this talk is to explain why our sales have fallen.
examples.uz: Ushbu nutqning maqsadi sotuvlarimiz nega tushganini tushuntirish.

examples.t: I'll be happy to take questions at the end.
examples.uz: Oxirida savollaringizga mamnuniyat bilan javob beraman.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: taqdimot tuzilmasi, avval kirish. Yaxshi kirish to‘rt qismdan iborat. Salomlashib, o‘zingizni tanishtirasiz. Mavzu va maqsadni aytasiz: the purpose of this talk is to. Rejani beraman: I’ve divided my talk into three parts. Va savollar qachon berilishini aytasiz: now yoki at the end. Bu to‘rt qism bir daqiqadan oshmasin, kirish qisqa bo‘lsa, tinglovchi diqqati saqlanadi.
scenes.say: The purpose of this talk is to explain why our sales have fallen. I've divided it into three parts, and I'll be happy to take questions at the end.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu nutqning maqsadi sotuvlarimiz nega tushganini tushuntirish. Men uni uch qismga bo‘ldim va oxirida savollarga mamnuniyat bilan javob beraman.

scenes.title: Namuna: kirish
board: Good morning, everyone. I'm Aziz, from the marketing team.
Today I'd like to talk about…
I'll be speaking for about ten minutes.
scenes.say_native: Mana to‘liq kirish namunasi. E’tibor bering: hammasi qisqa, aniq va do‘stona. Today I’d like to talk about kirish uchun eng xavfsiz ibora. I’ll be speaking for about ten minutes tinglovchiga vaqtni aytadi, bu hurmat belgisi. Kelasi zamonning davomli shakli I’ll be speaking rejalashtirilgan, tabiiy ishni bildiradi. Bu yerda future continuous ohangni yumshoq qiladi.
scenes.say: Good morning, everyone. I'm Aziz, from the marketing team. Today I'd like to talk about our new customer survey. I'll be speaking for about ten minutes, and I'll be happy to answer questions at the end.
scenes.say_uz: Hammaga xayrli tong. Men Aziz, marketing bo‘limidanman. Bugun yangi mijozlar so‘rovnomasi haqida gapirmoqchiman. Taxminan o‘n daqiqa gapiraman, oxirida savollarga mamnuniyat bilan javob beraman.

scenes.title: Asosiy qism: uchlik qoidasi
board: Body: 3 main points
Point → evidence → example
One idea per slide

examples.t: To illustrate this, let me give you an example.
examples.uz: Buni ko‘rsatish uchun bir misol keltiray.

scenes.say_native: Asosiy qismda uchlik qoidasi ishlaydi: odatda uchta asosiy fikr eng yaxshi eslab qolinadi. Ikkitasi kam tuyuladi, beshtasini tinglovchi unutadi. Har bir fikrni bir xil tuzilmada bering: fikr, dalil, misol. My first point concerns cost, keyin dalil, keyin to illustrate this, let me give you an example. Slaydda esa bitta g‘oya bo‘lsin, matn emas.
scenes.say: My first point concerns cost. Our expenses rose last year. To illustrate this, let me give you an example from our Tashkent office.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi fikrim xarajat haqida. O‘tgan yili xarajatlarimiz oshdi. Buni ko‘rsatish uchun Toshkent ofisimizdan bir misol keltiray.

scenes.title: Xulosa qismi
board: Summary: To sum up, …
Key message: The main thing to remember is…
Call to action + Thank you + Questions

examples.t: The main thing to remember is that small changes add up.
examples.uz: Eng muhim eslab qolish kerak bo‘lgan narsa: kichik o‘zgarishlar jamlanadi.

scenes.say_native: Xulosa qismi ham tuzilmaga ega. Avval qisqa takrorlash: to sum up yoki to recap. Keyin asosiy xabar: the main thing to remember is. So‘ng harakatga chaqiriq, call to action: tinglovchi ertaga nima qilishi kerak? Oxirida rahmat va savollarga taklif. Eng yomon yakun bu that’s all degan gap, u taqdimotni kutilmaganda uzib qo‘yadi.
scenes.say: To sum up, we've looked at three causes of the problem. The main thing to remember is that small changes add up. So I'd encourage you to try one this week. Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, muammoning uch sababini ko‘rdik. Eslab qolish kerak bo‘lgan asosiy narsa: kichik o‘zgarishlar jamlanadi. Shuning uchun bu hafta bittasini sinab ko‘rishingizni tavsiya qilaman. Rahmat.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha odat va inglizcha kutish
board: Uzbek style: long formal greeting, modesty
English style: short greeting, purpose first
✗ reading the slides aloud
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilidagi rasmiy nutq ko‘pincha uzun murojaat bilan boshlanadi: hurmatli rahbariyat, aziz hamkasblar, va kamtarlik iboralari bilan. Ingliz tilidagi taqdimotda esa qisqa salomdan keyin darhol maqsadga o‘tiladi. Uzun kirish auditoriyaga vaqtni tejamayotgandek tuyulishi mumkin. Yana bir odat, slayddagi matnni o‘qib berish. Tinglovchi o‘zi o‘qiy oladi, sizdan esa izoh va hikoya kutadi.
scenes.say: In English-speaking settings, keep the greeting short and get to the point quickly. Never simply read your slides aloud: your audience can read. They want your explanation.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilidagi muhitda salomni qisqa qiling va tezda asosiy masalaga o‘ting. Slaydni shunchaki o‘qib bermang: tinglovchi o‘qiy oladi. Ular sizning izohingizni kutadi.

scenes.title: Kirish va yakundagi xatolar
board: ✗ I want to present you my project. → ✓ I'd like to present my project to you.
✗ Let me introduce myself shortly. → ✓ …briefly.
✗ That's all. → ✓ That brings me to the end of my talk.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, present you my project. Present fe’li ikki to‘ldiruvchini give kabi olmaydi: present my project to you. Ikkinchisi, introduce myself shortly. Shortly bu tez orada degani, qisqacha esa briefly. Uchinchisi, that’s all bilan tugatish. U qo‘pol va kutilmagan eshitiladi. To‘g‘risi: that brings me to the end of my talk, thank you for listening.
scenes.say: Not present you my project, but present my project to you. Not introduce myself shortly, but briefly. And not that's all, but that brings me to the end of my talk.
scenes.say_uz: Present you my project emas, present my project to you. Shortly emas, briefly. That’s all emas, that brings me to the end of my talk.

scenes.title: Kirishni tartiblang
board: A) I've divided my talk into three parts.
B) Good afternoon. I'm Laylo, a data analyst.
C) Please feel free to interrupt with questions.
D) Today I'd like to talk about remote working.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskada kirishning to‘rt bo‘lagi aralash berilgan. Ularni to‘g‘ri tartibda joylashtiring va butun kirishni baland ovozda ayting. Esingizda bo‘lsin: salom va tanishuv, mavzu, reja, savollar haqida kelishuv. C bo‘lagi savollarni qachon berish mumkinligini aytayotganiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Put the four parts of this opening in the right order, then say the whole opening aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kirishning to‘rt qismini to‘g‘ri tartibga keltiring, so‘ng butun kirishni baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javob
board: B → D → A → C
scenes.say_native: Javob: B, D, A, C. Avval salom va tanishuv: good afternoon, I’m Laylo. Keyin mavzu: today I’d like to talk about remote working. So‘ng reja: I’ve divided my talk into three parts. Oxirida savollar haqida: please feel free to interrupt with questions, ya’ni savolni istalgan payt berishingiz mumkin. Bu yerda savollar oxirida emas, jarayonda qabul qilinadi.
scenes.say: Good afternoon. I'm Laylo, a data analyst. Today I'd like to talk about remote working. I've divided my talk into three parts. Please feel free to interrupt with questions.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kun. Men Laylo, ma’lumotlar tahlilchisiman. Bugun masofaviy ish haqida gapirmoqchiman. Nutqimni uch qismga bo‘ldim. Savollar bilan bemalol gapimni bo‘lishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: signposting nima?
board: Signposts = road signs for listeners
Moving on to… · Let's now turn to…
That leads me to my next point.

examples.t: Let's now turn to the second issue: staff training.
examples.uz: Endi ikkinchi masalaga, xodimlar malakasiga o‘tamiz.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: signposting, ya’ni yo‘naltiruvchi iboralar. Ular yo‘ldagi belgilarga o‘xshaydi: tinglovchiga hozir qayerda ekanini va qayerga ketayotganini ko‘rsatadi. Yangi qismga o‘tish uchun: moving on to, let’s now turn to, that leads me to my next point. O‘zbekchada ham endi esa, keyingi masala deymiz, lekin inglizcha taqdimotda bunday iboralar ancha ko‘p va muntazam ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Moving on to the budget. Let's now turn to the second issue: staff training. And that leads me to my next point.
scenes.say_uz: Budjetga o‘tamiz. Endi ikkinchi masalaga, xodimlar malakasiga o‘taylik. Bu meni keyingi fikrimga olib keladi.

scenes.title: Ketma-ketlik va orqaga qaytish
board: First of all · Secondly · Finally
As I mentioned earlier, …
I'll come back to this later.

examples.t: As I mentioned earlier, costs have risen.
I'll come back to this point in a moment.

scenes.say_native: Ketma-ketlik uchun first of all, secondly, finally. Lastly ham bo‘ladi, lekin oxirgi fikr eng muhim bo‘lsa, finally yaxshiroq. Oldingi fikrga qaytish uchun as I mentioned earlier yoki as we saw a moment ago. Keyinroq to‘xtalishni va’da qilish uchun I’ll come back to this later. Bu iboralar fikrlarni bir-biriga bog‘laydi va taqdimot bir butun bo‘lib eshitiladi.
scenes.say: First of all, let's look at the problem. As I mentioned earlier, costs have risen. I'll come back to this point in a moment. Finally, a word about next year.
scenes.say_uz: Avvalo muammoni ko‘raylik. Avvalroq aytganimdek, xarajatlar oshdi. Bu fikrga birozdan keyin qaytaman. Va nihoyat, kelasi yil haqida bir og‘iz so‘z.

scenes.title: Slayd va grafikka ishora
board: As you can see on this slide, …
If you look at this chart, you'll notice…
This graph shows… · The figures speak for themselves.

examples.t: If you look at this chart, you'll notice a sharp drop in March.
examples.uz: Bu diagrammaga qarasangiz, martdagi keskin pasayishni sezasiz.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘rgazmali vositaga ishora qilish iboralari. As you can see on this slide, slaydda ko‘rib turganingizdek. If you look at this chart, you’ll notice, ya’ni diqqatni aniq joyga qaratamiz. This graph shows. Muhim maslahat: grafikni ko‘rsatgandan keyin bir-ikki soniya jim turing, tinglovchiga uni ko‘rishga vaqt bering. Keyin faqat eng muhim bitta narsani izohlang, hamma raqamni emas.
scenes.say: If you look at this chart, you'll notice a sharp drop in March. As you can see on this slide, the figures recovered in the summer.
scenes.say_uz: Bu diagrammaga qarasangiz, martdagi keskin pasayishni sezasiz. Slaydda ko‘rib turganingizdek, yozda raqamlar tiklandi.

scenes.title: Urg‘u berish va chetga chiqish
board: Emphasis: What I'd like to stress is… · The key point is…
Digressing: Just a quick aside, …
Returning: Anyway, to get back to…

examples.t: What I'd like to stress is that this is only a pilot.
examples.uz: Ta’kidlamoqchi bo‘lganim shuki, bu faqat sinov loyihasi.

scenes.say_native: Muhim fikrga urg‘u berish uchun what I’d like to stress is yoki the key point here is. What bilan boshlanadigan bu tuzilma oldingi darslarda ko‘rgan cleft sentence, u diqqatni gapning oxiriga qaratadi. Mavzudan qisqa chetga chiqish: just a quick aside. Qaytish: anyway, to get back to. Bu iboralar tinglovchiga siz yo‘lni yo‘qotmaganingizni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: What I'd like to stress is that this is only a pilot. Just a quick aside: the same idea worked in Samarkand. Anyway, to get back to the main point.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’kidlamoqchi bo‘lganim shuki, bu faqat sinov loyihasi. Qisqa chekinish: xuddi shu g‘oya Samarqandda ish berdi. Xullas, asosiy fikrga qaytsak.

scenes.title: Signpostingdagi xatolar
board: ✗ This graphic shows… → ✓ This graph / chart shows…
✗ Firstly… Secondary… → ✓ Firstly… Secondly…
✗ In the end of my talk → ✓ At the end of my talk
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, grafik so‘zini graphic deb tarjima qilish. Graphic ko‘proq dizayn, tasvir ma’nosida. Ma’lumot chizig‘i graph, diagramma chart, ish grafigi esa schedule. Ikkinchisi, secondary: bu ikkinchi darajali degan sifat, tartib uchun secondly. Uchinchisi, in the end va at the end. At the end of my talk nutq oxirida, in the end esa oxir-oqibat degani.
scenes.say: Not this graphic shows, but this graph shows. Not secondary, but secondly. And not in the end of my talk, but at the end of my talk.
scenes.say_uz: This graphic shows emas, this graph shows. Secondary emas, secondly. In the end of my talk emas, at the end of my talk.

scenes.title: Signpostni tanlang
board: 1) You finish point one and start point two.
2) You show a chart.
3) You want to stress the main idea.
4) You return after a digression.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskada to‘rtta vaziyat bor. Har biri uchun mos yo‘naltiruvchi ibora ayting. Birinchi: birinchi fikrdan ikkinchisiga o‘tasiz. Ikkinchi: diagramma ko‘rsatasiz. Uchinchi: asosiy g‘oyaga urg‘u berasiz. To‘rtinchi: chetga chiqqandan keyin asosiy mavzuga qaytasiz. Har birini to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Give a signpost for each situation on the board. Say each one as a full sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi har bir vaziyat uchun yo‘naltiruvchi ibora ayting. Har birini to‘liq gap bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) That leads me to my second point.
2) If you look at this chart, you'll notice…
3) What I'd like to stress is…
4) Anyway, to get back to…
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: that leads me to my second point yoki moving on to my second point. Ikkinchi: if you look at this chart, you’ll notice yoki as you can see on this slide. Uchinchi: what I’d like to stress is yoki the key point here is. To‘rtinchi: anyway, to get back to the main point. Boshqa variantlar ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi vazifasi mos kelsin.
scenes.say: That leads me to my second point. If you look at this chart, you'll notice a clear trend. What I'd like to stress is this. Anyway, to get back to the main point.
scenes.say_uz: Bu meni ikkinchi fikrimga olib keladi. Bu diagrammaga qarasangiz, aniq tendensiyani sezasiz. Ta’kidlamoqchi bo‘lganim shu. Xullas, asosiy fikrga qaytsak.

scenes.title: Tinglash: taqdimotdan parcha
board: Speaker: survey results
chart · two findings · next section
Listen for the signposts
scenes.say_native: Endi taqdimotdan bir parchani tinglang. Notiq mijozlar so‘rovnomasi natijalarini aytmoqda. Signposting iboralarini sanab boring: u qanday qilib diagrammaga ishora qiladi, nimaga urg‘u beradi va keyin qaysi qismga o‘tadi. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: So, that's the background. Now, if you look at this chart, you'll notice two things. First of all, most complaints are about delivery times, not prices. Secondly, younger customers are far more likely to complain online. What I'd like to stress is that both problems can be fixed quickly. That leads me to the next section: our action plan.
scenes.say_uz: Xullas, bu tarix. Endi bu diagrammaga qarasangiz, ikki narsani sezasiz. Avvalo, shikoyatlarning ko‘pi narx emas, yetkazib berish muddati haqida. Ikkinchidan, yosh mijozlar onlayn shikoyat qilishga ancha moyil. Ta’kidlamoqchi bo‘lganim, ikkala muammoni tez hal qilish mumkin. Bu meni keyingi qismga, harakat rejamizga olib keladi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What are most complaints about?
2) What does the speaker stress?
3) What comes next in the talk?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: shikoyatlarning ko‘pi nima haqida? Ikkinchi: notiq nimaga urg‘u beradi va qaysi ibora bilan? Uchinchi: taqdimotning keyingi qismi nima? Javobingizni to‘liq inglizcha gap bilan bering va notiqning signpostlarini eslab qolishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One. What are most complaints about? Two. What does the speaker stress? Three. What comes next in the talk?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Shikoyatlarning ko‘pi nima haqida? Ikki. Notiq nimaga urg‘u beradi? Uch. Keyin nima keladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Delivery times, not prices
2) Both problems can be fixed quickly
3) The action plan
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: shikoyatlarning ko‘pi narx emas, yetkazib berish muddati haqida. Ikkinchi: notiq what I’d like to stress is iborasi bilan ikkala muammoni tez hal qilish mumkinligiga urg‘u beradi. Uchinchi: that leads me to the next section, ya’ni harakat rejasi. Notiq ikkita fikrni first of all va secondly bilan ajratganiga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Most complaints are about delivery times. The speaker stresses that both problems can be fixed quickly. Next comes the action plan.
scenes.say_uz: Shikoyatlarning ko‘pi yetkazib berish muddati haqida. Notiq ikkala muammoni tez hal qilish mumkinligini ta’kidlaydi. Keyin harakat rejasi keladi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: diqqatni tortish
board: Hook: a question · a story · a striking image
Imagine you… · Have you ever…?
How many of you…?

examples.t: Have you ever waited three weeks for a parcel?
Imagine you could save an hour every day.
examples.uz: Har kuni bir soat tejay olishingizni tasavvur qiling.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: auditoriyani jalb qilish. Birinchi o‘ttiz soniya hal qiluvchi, shuning uchun taqdimotni hook bilan boshlang. Hook bu savol, qisqa hikoya yoki ta’sirli tasvir. Have you ever, imagine you, how many of you kabi boshlanishlar tinglovchini darhol fikrlashga majbur qiladi. Ishonchli manbangiz bo‘lmasa, hayratlanarli raqam o‘ylab topmang, hikoya yoki savol xavfsizroq.
scenes.say: Have you ever waited three weeks for a parcel? Imagine you could save an hour every day. How many of you checked your phone before breakfast this morning?
scenes.say_uz: Hech posilkani uch hafta kutganmisiz? Har kuni bir soat tejay olishingizni tasavvur qiling. Bugun nonushtadan oldin qaysi biringiz telefoningizni tekshirdingiz?

scenes.title: Siz va biz tili
board: you-language: You may be wondering…
inclusive we: Let's look at… · We all know…
Think about your own…

examples.t: You may be wondering why this matters.
examples.uz: Bu nega muhimligini o‘ylayotgan bo‘lishingiz mumkin.

examples.t: Let's look at what this means for us.
examples.uz: Bu biz uchun nimani anglatishini ko‘raylik.

scenes.say_native: Tinglovchini ishtirokchiga aylantirish uchun you va we so‘zlarini ko‘proq ishlating. You may be wondering why this matters, ya’ni siz o‘ylayotgan savolni oldindan aytib berasiz. Let’s look at, we all know kabi iboralar notiq va auditoriyani bir jamoaga birlashtiradi. Think about your own team esa har bir tinglovchini mavzuni o‘z hayotiga bog‘lashga undaydi.
scenes.say: You may be wondering why this matters. Well, think about your own team. Let's look at what this means for all of us.
scenes.say_uz: Bu nega muhimligini o‘ylayotgan bo‘lishingiz mumkin. O‘z jamoangiz haqida o‘ylab ko‘ring. Keling, bu barchamiz uchun nimani anglatishini ko‘raylik.

scenes.title: Ritorik usullar
board: Rule of three: faster, cheaper, safer
Contrast: It's not about cost; it's about trust.
Repetition: We can. We must. We will.

examples.t: The new system is faster, cheaper and safer.
examples.uz: Yangi tizim tezroq, arzonroq va xavfsizroq.

scenes.say_native: Nutqni esda qolarli qiladigan uchta ritorik usul. Birinchisi, uchlik: faster, cheaper and safer, uchta so‘z ritm hosil qiladi. Ikkinchisi, qarama-qarshilik: it’s not about cost, it’s about trust. Ikkinchi qism kutilmagan bo‘lgani uchun yodda qoladi. Uchinchisi, takror: we can, we must, we will. Bu usullarni har gapda emas, faqat eng muhim joyda, bir-ikki marta ishlating.
scenes.say: The new system is faster, cheaper and safer. In the end, it's not about cost; it's about trust.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi tizim tezroq, arzonroq va xavfsizroq. Oxir-oqibat gap xarajatda emas, ishonchda.

scenes.title: Ovoz va tana tili
board: Eye contact with the whole room
Pause before and after key points
Slow down; vary your pace
scenes.say_native: Auditoriyani so‘z bilangina emas, ovoz va tana tili bilan ham jalb qilasiz. O‘zbek madaniyatida kattalarning ko‘ziga uzoq tikilmaslik odob hisoblanishi mumkin, lekin ingliz tilidagi taqdimotda zalning turli qismlariga qarab gapirish ishonch belgisi. Muhim fikrdan oldin va keyin pauza qiling. Hayajonda ko‘pchilik tezlashadi, shuning uchun ataylab sekinroq gapiring va tezlikni o‘zgartirib turing.
scenes.say: Look at the whole room, not just your slides. Pause before a key point. And after it, pause again. Silence gives your words weight.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat slaydga emas, butun zalga qarang. Muhim fikrdan oldin pauza qiling. Undan keyin yana pauza qiling. Sukunat so‘zlaringizga salmoq beradi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bo‘laklash va kuchsiz shakllar
board: Let's move on | to the NEXT point.
to /tə/ · for /fə/ · of /əv/ · can /kən/
That leads me | to my SECond point.
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz nuqtasi. Tabiiy nutqda gap bo‘laklarga bo‘linadi va har bo‘lakda bitta asosiy urg‘u bo‘ladi: let’s move on, pauza, to the NEXT point. Signpostlardagi kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz shaklda aytiladi: to tə, for fə, of əv, can kən. Ko‘pchilik o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar har so‘zni to‘liq aytadi, natijada nutq robotga o‘xshab qoladi. Kichik so‘zlarni qisqa, asosiy so‘zlarni aniq ayting.
scenes.say: Let's move on to the next point. That leads me to my second point. I can show you some of the results.
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi fikrga o‘tamiz. Bu meni ikkinchi fikrimga olib keladi. Sizga natijalarning bir qismini ko‘rsata olaman.

scenes.title: Pauza va urg‘uni belgilang
board: What I'd like to stress is that this is only the beginning.
Mark one pause | and the key stressed word
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskadagi gapni o‘qishdan oldin uni qayerda pauza bilan bo‘lishni va qaysi so‘zga asosiy urg‘u tushishini o‘ylang. Keyin gapni sekin, kichik so‘zlarni kuchsiz shaklda, baland ovozda ayting. Keyingi qismda namunani eshitib, o‘zingizni solishtirasiz.
scenes.say: Read this sentence aloud. Where do you pause, and which word carries the main stress?
scenes.say_uz: Bu gapni baland ovozda o‘qing. Qayerda pauza qilasiz va asosiy urg‘u qaysi so‘zga tushadi?

scenes.title: Javob
board: What I'd like to stress is | that this is only the BEginning.
to /tə/ · that /ðət/
scenes.say_native: Javob. Pauza what I’d like to stress is dan keyin keladi, chunki bu iboradan keyin tinglovchi asosiy fikrni kutadi. Asosiy urg‘u beginning so‘ziga, aniqrog‘i uning ikkinchi bo‘g‘iniga tushadi: be-GIN-ning. Gap boshidagi stress so‘zi ham urg‘uli, lekin eng kuchlisi yangi ma’lumotda. That bu yerda bog‘lovchi, shuning uchun kuchsiz aytiladi: ðət.
scenes.say: What I'd like to stress is... that this is only the beginning.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’kidlamoqchi bo‘lganim shuki... bu faqat boshlanishi.

scenes.title: Diqqatni o‘ldiradigan odatlar
board: ✗ Sorry, my English is not very good.
✗ I'll try not to bore you.
✓ I'm delighted to be here. Let's start with a question.
scenes.say_native: Auditoriyani yo‘qotadigan odatlar. Birinchisi, uzr bilan boshlash: sorry, my English is not very good. Tinglovchi darhol xatolaringizni qidira boshlaydi. Ikkinchisi, I’ll try not to bore you: siz o‘zingiz zerikarli bo‘lishni bashorat qildingiz. O‘zbekchadagi kamtarlik inglizchada ishonchsizlik bo‘lib eshitiladi. Uning o‘rniga ijobiy boshlang: I’m delighted to be here, let’s start with a question.
scenes.say: Don't apologise for your English, and don't promise not to bore people. Start positively: I'm delighted to be here. Let's start with a question.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilingiz uchun uzr so‘ramang va zeriktirmaslikka va’da bermang. Ijobiy boshlang: bu yerda bo‘lganimdan xursandman. Keling, bir savoldan boshlaymiz.

scenes.title: Zerikarli boshlanishni o‘zgartiring
board: Dull: My presentation is about road safety. I have ten slides.
Rewrite with a hook: a question or 'Imagine…'
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskadagi boshlanish to‘g‘ri, lekin zerikarli: my presentation is about road safety, I have ten slides. Uni hook bilan qayta yozing. Savol yoki imagine bilan boshlang, keyin mavzuni ayting. Qo‘rqmang, ijodiy bo‘ling, lekin o‘ylab topilgan raqam ishlatmang.
scenes.say: Rewrite this dull opening with a hook. My presentation is about road safety. I have ten slides.
scenes.say_uz: Bu zerikarli boshlanishni hook bilan qayta yozing. Taqdimotim yo‘l xavfsizligi haqida. Menda o‘nta slayd bor.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: How many of you crossed a busy road this morning?
Imagine your child walking to school alone.
Today I'd like to talk about road safety.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi variant: how many of you crossed a busy road this morning? Keyin today I’d like to talk about road safety. Ikkinchi variant: imagine your child walking to school alone, what would worry you most? Ikkalasida ham tinglovchi mavzuni o‘ziga bog‘laydi. Slaydlar soni esa umuman aytilmadi, u tinglovchi uchun muhim emas.
scenes.say: How many of you crossed a busy road this morning? Today I'd like to talk about road safety. Or: imagine your child walking to school alone. What would worry you most?
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi biringiz bugun ertalab gavjum yo‘ldan o‘tdingiz? Bugun yo‘l xavfsizligi haqida gapirmoqchiman. Yoki: farzandingiz maktabga yolg‘iz ketayotganini tasavvur qiling. Sizni eng ko‘p nima xavotirga soladi?

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: savollarni qabul qilish
board: Inviting: What questions do you have?
Welcoming: Thank you for raising that.
Clarifying: If I understand you correctly, you're asking…

examples.t: If I understand you correctly, you're asking about the cost.
examples.uz: Sizni to‘g‘ri tushungan bo‘lsam, narx haqida so‘rayapsiz.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: savollarga javob. Do you have any questions savoli ko‘pincha sukunatga olib keladi, chunki unga yo‘q deb javob berish oson. What questions do you have esa savol borligini taxmin qiladi va odamlarni rag‘batlantiradi. Savolni olqishlang: thank you for raising that. Savol tushunarsiz bo‘lsa, uni qayta ifodalang: if I understand you correctly, you’re asking about. Bu ham aniqlik, ham o‘ylash uchun vaqt beradi.
scenes.say: So, what questions do you have? Thank you for raising that. If I understand you correctly, you're asking about the cost of the pilot.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, qanday savollaringiz bor? Buni ko‘targaningiz uchun rahmat. Sizni to‘g‘ri tushungan bo‘lsam, sinov loyihasi narxi haqida so‘rayapsiz.

scenes.title: Qiyin savollar
board: Don't know: I'm afraid I don't have that figure to hand, but I'll get back to you.
Off-topic: That's slightly beyond the scope of today's talk.
Critical: I take your point. However, …

examples.t: I'm afraid I don't have that figure to hand.
examples.uz: Afsuski, bu raqam hozir qo‘limda yo‘q.

scenes.say_native: Qiyin savollar uchun tayyor iboralar. Javobni bilmasangiz, taxmin qilmang: I’m afraid I don’t have that figure to hand, but I’ll get back to you. Va albatta keyin javob bering. Savol mavzudan tashqari bo‘lsa: that’s slightly beyond the scope of today’s talk, but I’m happy to discuss it afterwards. Tanqidiy savolga: I take your point, however. Avval tan oling, keyin fikringizni himoya qiling.
scenes.say: I'm afraid I don't have that figure to hand, but I'll get back to you. That's slightly beyond the scope of today's talk. I take your point. However, the pilot results were encouraging.
scenes.say_uz: Afsuski, bu raqam hozir qo‘limda yo‘q, lekin keyinroq javob beraman. Bu bugungi nutq doirasidan biroz tashqarida. Fikringizni tushunaman. Biroq sinov natijalari umidli bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Vaqt yutish
board: That's an interesting question.
Let me think about that for a moment.
There are two sides to that.

examples.t: Let me think about that for a moment.
examples.uz: Bu haqda bir lahza o‘ylab ko‘ray.

scenes.say_native: Qiyin savoldan keyin o‘ylash uchun vaqt kerak. Jim qolib ketmaslik uchun bunday iboralar bor: that’s an interesting question, let me think about that for a moment, there are two sides to that. Ular sizga ikki-uch soniya beradi va professional eshitiladi. Faqat that’s a good question ni har savolga qaytarmang, u mexanik tuyuladi va tinglovchi buni sezadi.
scenes.say: That's an interesting question. Let me think about that for a moment. Well, there are really two sides to that.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qiziq savol. Bu haqda bir lahza o‘ylab ko‘ray. Xo‘sh, bu masalaning aslida ikki tomoni bor.

scenes.title: Savol-javobdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I don't know. → ✓ I'm afraid I don't know, but I'll find out.
✗ Answer on your question… → ✓ To answer your question…
✗ Good question! (every time)
scenes.say_native: Savol-javobdagi xatolar. Birinchisi, quruq I don’t know. Bu to‘g‘ri, lekin juda keskin eshitiladi: I’m afraid I don’t know, but I’ll find out deyish ancha yaxshi. Ikkinchisi, ruschadagi ответ на вопрос ta’sirida answer on your question. To‘g‘risi to answer your question yoki in answer to your question. Uchinchisi, har savolga good question deyish. Iborangizni almashtirib turing.
scenes.say: Not just I don't know, but I'm afraid I don't know, but I'll find out. Not answer on your question, but to answer your question.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat I don’t know emas, I’m afraid I don’t know, but I’ll find out. Answer on your question emas, to answer your question.

scenes.title: Savolga javob bering
board: 1) You don't know the exact cost.
2) The question is about a different project.
3) Someone says your plan is too expensive.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta vaziyat. Birinchi: sizdan aniq narxni so‘rashdi, siz bilmaysiz. Ikkinchi: savol boshqa loyiha haqida, mavzudan tashqarida. Uchinchi: kimdir rejangizni juda qimmat deb tanqid qildi. Har biriga bir-ikki gapli diplomatik javob bering. Darsdagi iboralardan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Respond to each situation on the board in one or two diplomatic sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi har bir vaziyatga bir-ikki gapli diplomatik javob bering.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) I'm afraid I don't have that figure to hand, but I'll get back to you.
2) That's slightly beyond the scope of today's talk.
3) I take your point. However, it will save money in the long run.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: I’m afraid I don’t have that figure to hand, but I’ll get back to you. Ikkinchi: that’s slightly beyond the scope of today’s talk, but I’m happy to discuss it afterwards. Uchinchi: I take your point. However, it will save money in the long run. Uchinchi javobda avval tanqidni tan oldik, keyin however bilan dalil keltirdik.
scenes.say: I'm afraid I don't have that figure to hand, but I'll get back to you. That's slightly beyond the scope of today's talk. I take your point. However, it will save money in the long run.
scenes.say_uz: Afsuski, bu raqam hozir qo‘limda yo‘q, lekin keyinroq javob beraman. Bu bugungi nutq doirasidan biroz tashqarida. Fikringizni tushunaman. Biroq bu uzoq muddatda pul tejaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: savol-javob
board: Audience member: training costs?
Presenter: clarifies · admits · promises
Second question: competitors
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Taqdimotdan keyin savol-javob qismi. Taqdimotchi ikki savolga javob beradi. Uning savolni qanday aniqlashtirishiga, nimani bilmasligini qanday tan olishiga va ikkinchi savolga qanday munosabat bildirishiga e’tibor bering. Ikkala savolga ham u to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri yo‘q demaydi, buni qanday uddalaganini kuzating.
scenes.say: Woman: How much will the staff training cost? Presenter: Thank you for raising that. Do you mean the cost per person or the total? Woman: The total. Presenter: I'm afraid I don't have the final figure to hand, but I'll email it to everyone by Friday. Man: What are our competitors doing? Presenter: That's slightly beyond the scope of today's talk, but I'd be happy to discuss it over coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Ayol: Xodimlar o‘qitilishi qanchaga tushadi? Taqdimotchi: Buni ko‘targaningiz uchun rahmat. Bir kishiga narxnimi yoki umumiy narxnimi nazarda tutyapsiz? Ayol: Umumiy. Taqdimotchi: Afsuski, yakuniy raqam hozir qo‘limda yo‘q, lekin jumagacha hammaga elektron pochta orqali yuboraman. Erkak: Raqobatchilarimiz nima qilyapti? Taqdimotchi: Bu bugungi nutq doirasidan biroz tashqarida, lekin qahva ustida mamnuniyat bilan gaplashaman.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) How does the presenter clarify the first question?
2) What does he promise?
3) How does he deal with the second question?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: taqdimotchi birinchi savolni qanday aniqlashtiradi? Ikkinchi: u nimani va qachongacha va’da qiladi? Uchinchi: ikkinchi savolga qanday javob beradi va nega? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Taqdimotchi ishlatgan aniq iboralarni ham eslashga harakat qiling, ular sizga keyingi topshiriqda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: One. How does the presenter clarify the first question? Two. What does he promise? Three. How does he deal with the second question?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Taqdimotchi birinchi savolni qanday aniqlashtiradi? Ikki. U nimani va’da qiladi? Uch. Ikkinchi savolga qanday munosabat bildiradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Cost per person or the total?
2) To email the total figure by Friday
3) Beyond the scope → discuss it over coffee
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: u so‘raydi, do you mean the cost per person or the total, ya’ni savolni aniqlashtiradi. Ikkinchi: yakuniy raqamni juma kunigacha hammaga elektron pochta orqali yuborishni va’da qiladi. Uchinchi: savol mavzudan tashqarida, shuning uchun beyond the scope of today’s talk deydi, lekin keyin qahva ustida gaplashishni taklif qiladi. Rad etish, lekin xushmuomalalik bilan.
scenes.say: He asks whether she means the cost per person or the total, promises to email the figure by Friday, and politely postpones the second question.
scenes.say_uz: U bir kishiga narxmi yoki umumiy narxmi, deb so‘raydi, raqamni jumagacha yuborishni va’da qiladi va ikkinchi savolni xushmuomalalik bilan keyinga qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bir daqiqalik taqdimot
board: Topic: a place, a habit or an idea you recommend
Hook → purpose → 2 points with signposts
Summary → call to action → What questions do you have?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. O‘zingiz tavsiya qiladigan joy, odat yoki g‘oya haqida bir daqiqalik qisqa taqdimot tayyorlang. Hook bilan boshlang, maqsadni ayting, ikkita fikrni signpostlar bilan bering, xulosa va harakatga chaqiriq bilan tugating, oxirida savollarga taklif qiling. Bir oz tayyorlaning, keyin turib, baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Prepare a one-minute talk recommending a place, a habit or an idea. Use a hook, signposts, a summary and a call to action. Then stand up and deliver it.
scenes.say_uz: Joy, odat yoki g‘oyani tavsiya qiluvchi bir daqiqalik nutq tayyorlang. Hook, signpost, xulosa va harakatga chaqiriqdan foydalaning. Keyin turib, uni ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna va tekshiruv
board: Have you ever felt too tired to think?
First of all… · Secondly… · To sum up…
So why not try it tonight? What questions do you have?
scenes.say_native: Namuna: have you ever felt too tired to think? Today I’d like to recommend one simple habit: going to bed at the same time every night. First of all, it improves concentration. Secondly, it helps your mood. To sum up, why not try it tonight? Endi o‘zingizni tekshiring: hook bormi, signpostlar aniqmi, harakatga chaqiriq va savolga taklif bormi?
scenes.say: Have you ever felt too tired to think? Today I'd like to recommend one habit: going to bed at the same time every night. First of all, it sharpens your concentration. Secondly, it lifts your mood. So why not try it tonight?
scenes.say_uz: Hech fikrlashga kuchingiz qolmaganini his qilganmisiz? Bugun bitta odatni tavsiya qilmoqchiman: har kecha bir vaqtda yotish. Avvalo, bu diqqatni oshiradi. Ikkinchidan, kayfiyatni ko‘taradi. Nega bugun kechqurun sinab ko‘rmaysiz?

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
board: 1 Structure: opening · 3 points · closing
2 Signposts: Moving on to… · As you can see…
3 Engage: hook · you / we · rule of three
4 Questions: clarify · admit · get back to
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: tuzilma, ya’ni qisqa kirish, uchta asosiy fikr va xulosa, harakatga chaqiriq bilan. Ikkinchi: signpostlar, tinglovchining xaritasi: moving on to, as you can see on this slide, what I’d like to stress is. Uchinchi: auditoriyani hook, you va we tili, uchlik qoidasi va pauzalar bilan jalb qilish. To‘rtinchi: savolni aniqlashtirish, bilmaganni tan olish va keyin javob berishni va’da qilish.
scenes.say: To recap: a clear structure, plenty of signposts, a strong hook, and calm, honest answers to questions.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: aniq tuzilma, ko‘p signpostlar, kuchli hook va savollarga xotirjam, halol javoblar.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: give a 3-minute presentation (record it)
Hook · outline · 3 points · summary · call to action
6+ signposts · 2 likely questions with answers
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda uch daqiqalik taqdimot tayyorlab, uni video yoki audioga yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: hook, reja, uchta asosiy fikr, xulosa va harakatga chaqiriq bor, kamida oltita signpost ishlatilgan, vaqt uch daqiqadan oshmagan. Bundan tashqari, ehtimoliy ikkita savol va ularga javobni yozib qo‘ying. Keyingi darsda ohang orqali ma’no berishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, give and record a three-minute presentation, and prepare answers to two likely questions. Next time, we'll explore how intonation conveys meaning.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uch daqiqalik taqdimot qiling va uni yozib oling, ehtimoliy ikki savolga javob tayyorlang. Keyingi safar ohang ma’noni qanday berishini o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda 3 daqiqalik taqdimot tayyorlang va uni video yoki audioga yozib oling. Mezon: hook, reja, uchta asosiy fikr, xulosa va harakatga chaqiriq bor; kamida 6 ta signpost ishlatilgan; vaqt 3 daqiqadan oshmagan; ehtimoliy 2 ta savol va ularga diplomatik javoblar yozib qo‘yilgan.

options: I want to present you my project.
I'd like to present my project to you.
I'd like to present to you about my project.
Let me present you about my project.
quiz.why_uz: Present something to someone tuzilmasi ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Which is the best way to end a presentation?
options: That brings me to the end of my talk. Thank you for listening.
quiz.why_uz: That’s all qo‘pol va kutilmagan eshitiladi.

quiz.q: Which phrase moves the talk to a new section?
quiz.why_uz: Let’s now turn to yangi qismga o‘tishni bildiradi.

quiz.q: Choose the correct word: 'This ___ shows our sales over five years.'
quiz.why_uz: Ma’lumot chizig‘i graph, graphic esa dizayn tasviri; schedule ish jadvali.

quiz.q: '___ the end of my talk, there will be time for questions.'
quiz.why_uz: At the end of nimaningdir oxirida; in the end oxir-oqibat degani.

quiz.q: Which opening is most likely to engage an audience?
options: Sorry, my English is not very good.
I'll try not to bore you.
Have you ever waited three weeks for a parcel?
quiz.why_uz: Savol bilan boshlash (hook) tinglovchini darhol jalb qiladi.

quiz.q: Which question invites the most questions from the audience?
quiz.why_uz: What questions do you have savol borligini taxmin qiladi va rag‘batlantiradi.

quiz.q: You don't know the answer. What is the best response?
options: I'm afraid I don't have that figure to hand, but I'll get back to you.
Answer on your question is no.
quiz.why_uz: Bilmaganni xushmuomala tan olib, keyin javob berishni va’da qiling.
Shortly tez orada, briefly qisqacha degani.

quiz.q: How is 'to' usually pronounced in 'Let's move on to the next point'?
quiz.why_uz: Signpostlardagi to odatda kuchsiz shaklda /tə/ aytiladi.
